title: Smoky Jeweled Skewers
description: A flavorful and colorful skewer recipe that combines smoky and jeweled flavors with a hint of ancient Egyptian spices. Perfect for outdoor gatherings or a quick weeknight meal.

ingredients.name: Egyptian Spices
ingredients.notes: A blend of paprika, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper

instructions: Thread the jeweled eggplant, egyptian spices, and garlic onto the skewers.
Brush the skewers with smoky olive oil.
Grill the skewers for 8-10 minutes, turning occasionally.
Brush the skewers with lemon juice during the last 2 minutes of grilling.
